notes: 6 figures added. All generated programmatically from each problem's own coordinates (single grid_svg generator) then re-read against the display text: every plotted point and label matches the numbers exactly. Theme-safe: axes/gridlines/labels use currentColor (gridlines stroke-opacity 0.12); object points soft blue, image points soft amber, both fill-opacity ~0.5; centres drawn as a currentColor cross. No external refs, no scripts; each SVG 2.2-3.3KB. Bronze single-point translate/reflect/enlarge-from-origin problems left figure-free: they are pure coordinate computations where the exam does not necessarily print a shape, and their text is self-contained (claims no figure). Diagram pass changed no solutions, options, hints, or misconceptions beyond the two describe-question redesigns already logged in the main changes file (S2/G2 grids show the redesigned points).
